tools.name: token_check
tools.description: What can be checked about one crypto token: code activity on GitHub, fees and TVL, whether CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap agree on price, supply, market cap and volume, and, for the top 1000, what the chain says: paper vs real market cap (order-book depth), how much of the reported volume the order boo

tools.name: find_tokens
tools.description: Find tokens by category, live code, real fees, or an on-chain signal, e.g. “DePIN tokens with live code” or “tokens whose market cap is mostly paper”. Signals cover the top 1000: thin = real cap under half the market cap (order books too shallow for its size), unbacked = under half the volume venues

tools.name: sources_disagree
tools.description: Tokens where CoinGecko and CoinMarketCap disagree most on a metric, among tokens both put at $1M or more. Use for questions about which market caps or supply figures differ.

tools.name: check_contract
tools.description: Given a token contract address (EVM 0x… or Solana), say what it is: a token’s own contract, an official deployment, a listed wrapper or bridge, or a copy trading under a real token’s ticker that no list names, and whether that copy’s owner can take or freeze tokens. Use before anyone buys or bridges

tools.name: recent_signals
tools.description: What changed on-chain for the top 1000 tokens in the last month, newest first: unlocks within a week that the market can’t absorb (unlock), contract owners gaining powers or handing the contract on (admin), large holders sending to or taking from exchange addresses, or locked tokens reaching wallets

tools.name: market_gauges
